result:
The decisive mistake was made by Verification_Expert at Step 5. The search results contained clear evidence on the candidate hikes, such as Trout Lake Trail (about 87 reviews, recommended for young kids) and Fountain Paint Pot (374 reviews). Instead of using it carefully, Verification_Expert produced a final list without checking the "recommended by at least three people with kids" criterion. The agent also never read actual average ratings, only wrote "High" or "above 4.5". It then included non-hikes or unsupported items (Mammoth Terraces, Old Faithful, Mount Washburn, West Thumb) and dropped Trout Lake. As a result, the final answer was wrong, and the other agents simply accepted it.

AGENT: Verification_Expert
STEP: 5
